def forward(groups):
    date_part = groups[0]  # YYMMDD
    space_part = groups[1]  # Space separator
    time_part = groups[2]  # HHMMSS
    packed = int(date_part + time_part)  # Combine date and time
    layout = [len(space_part)]  # Store space length
    return {'stored': [packed], 'layout': layout}

def inverse(record):
    packed = str(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record['layout']
    date_part = packed[:6]
    time_part = packed[6:]
    space_part = ' ' * layout[0]  # Reconstruct space separator
    return f"{date_part}{space_part}{time_part}"
